punchline: One cave pointed to two serious cases, but the samples showed no virus.
thirty_sec: People who had visited Kitum Cave fell ill with Marburg virus in 1980 and in 1987, the second a 15-year-old Danish boy; samples from animals in and around the cave found no filovirus.
question: Which question on your desk looks closed but is only missing evidence?
key_contrast: Closing the file because nothing was found versus recording what was ruled out and leaving the question open.
